model.label: Model
model.description: Which model of the profile answers your messages.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling randomness: lower is focused and repeatable, higher is diverse.

top_p.label: Top P
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: the model considers only the most probable tokens covering this share. Change it instead of temperature, not together with it.

max_tokens.label: Max tokens
max_tokens.description: Upper bound on the answer length in tokens; the request fails when the answer needs more.

frequency_penalty.label: Frequency penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Penalty on tokens by how often they already appeared: positive values reduce repetition.

presence_penalty.label: Presence penalty
presence_penalty.description: Penalty on tokens that already appeared at all: positive values push the answer to new topics.

stop.label: Stop sequences
stop.description: Sequences that stop the generation; the sequence itself is not part of the answer.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Sampling seed: the same seed and parameters make the answer repeatable. Empty — the provider picks it.

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoning_effort.description: How long a reasoning model thinks before answering: more effort means slower but deeper answers.

history_messages.label: History messages
history_messages.description: How many previous messages of the thread are sent to the model.

user_prompt.label: Custom instructions
user_prompt.description: Your own instructions; they are appended to the profile system prompt and apply to every answer.
